name: replace derivatives by difference quotients on a grid
mechanism: lay a grid over the domain, replace each derivative in the equation by a difference of neighbouring grid values divided by the spacing, and solve the resulting algebraic system for the grid values

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Finite difference method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:

fails_when: irregular domains fit badly; error scales with spacing to a low power
